7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium French Vanilla Cappuccino is about $4.95, with 230 calories, 120 mg of caffeine and 31 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Calories, caffeine and sugar are from the official guide. Prices are researched estimates for a classic espresso drink and vary by market.

Is there a sugar-free French Vanilla Cappuccino?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (frozen chiller):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
French Vanilla Cappuccino23031 g34 g120 mg
Sugar-free French Vanilla Cappuccino1609 g20 g120 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

French Vanilla Cappuccino allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the French Vanilla Cappuccino. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a French Vanilla Cappuccino

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium French Vanilla Cappuccino?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a French Vanilla Cappuccino at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Two syrups, equal parts. The vanilla brings the custard note, the caramel brings the warmth, and blending it as a chiller copies the version 7 Brew actually publishes numbers for.

For one medium French Vanilla Cappuccino chiller (24 oz cup)

  • 1/2 oz vanilla syrup
  • 1/2 oz caramel syrup or sauce
  • About 6 oz milk
  • 2 shots of espresso (about 2 oz), cooled a few minutes
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Add both syrups, the milk, the espresso and the ice to a blender.
  2. Blend until smooth and thick, about 30 seconds.
  3. Pour into the cup. A caramel drizzle on top is the classic finish.

Hot cappuccino style: steam 8 oz of milk with the two syrups, pour over 2 shots and spoon a thick cap of foam on top, the classic thirds structure. Sugar-free version: sugar-free vanilla and caramel syrups. At the stand, the sugar-free medium chiller runs 160 calories with 9 g of sugar, going by the official guide. No espresso machine? Use 2 oz of very strong coffee, cooled.

7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino?

A medium frozen chiller French Vanilla Cappuccino has 230 calories. A small has 190 and a large 250, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino?

About 120 mg in a medium. Small is 120 mg and large is 240 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino cost?

Roughly $4.25 for a small, $4.95 for a medium and $5.75 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino?

31 g in a medium, or 9 g if you order the sugar-free version.

What is in a 7 Brew French Vanilla Cappuccino?

Espresso, milk and two flavors: vanilla and caramel. The official menu line is literally 'Vanilla + Caramel Cappuccino.' There is no hazelnut in the 7 Brew build, whatever traditional French vanilla recipes use. Think of it as the cappuccino sibling of the Blondie, which pairs the same two flavors in a richer breve base.

What makes it 'French' vanilla?

French vanilla means the custard-style vanilla, richer and rounder than plain vanilla, named after French ice cream made with egg yolks. 7 Brew gets that richness by pairing vanilla with caramel instead of using a separate custard flavor.

Is the French Vanilla Cappuccino hot or frozen?

The menu describes the cappuccinos served hot with foam, but the official nutrition guide publishes this drink's regular numbers only as a Frozen Chiller, and every figure on this page is that official chiller figure. Most fan pages print the same numbers and call them hot. They are the chiller numbers.

How many calories are in the sugar-free French Vanilla Cappuccino?

The sugar-free medium Frozen Chiller has 160 calories and 9 g of sugar, against 230 calories and 31 g in the regular. One quirk: the guide's sugar-free rows are partial. It lists that medium chiller plus hot small and large, and no hot medium. We print exactly what the guide publishes, nothing filled in.

How do I make a French vanilla cappuccino at home?

Blend 1/2 oz vanilla syrup and 1/2 oz caramel with about 6 oz of milk, 2 shots of espresso and a full cup of ice. That copies the Frozen Chiller, the version with official numbers. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
